name: SAMYANG
source: https://www.lksamyang.com/assets/images/img_SAMYANG.svg (official LK Samyang / Samyang Optics website header logo, referenced from https://www.lksamyang.com/assets/css/sy.common.css)
license: Public domain in the US as a simple text logo (PD-textlogo per Wikimedia Commons determination for the identical design, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Samyang_logo.png); vector paths taken from the brand's official website SVG (no explicit license; trademark)
trademark: LK Samyang Co., Ltd. (formerly Samyang Optics Co., Ltd.)
notes: Kept only the 7 red (#c40d3c) SAMYANG letter paths. Removed the grey "A New Perspective" tagline, the orange-gradient slash accent after the G (secondary colour layer, clip-path + gradient), and an empty <text> element (no glyphs). Source had no transforms on the letters; converted to absolute coordinates and shifted to origin. The two A counters are separate subpaths, so fillRule evenodd.
